stem.en: The word dharma comes from the root dhri, also the root of dharati, the earth. Bhishma says dharma "is that which upholds beings". Which idea joins these facts?

text.en: Dharma is about farming the land.
Dharma is the name of a Vedic goddess of the earth.
Dharma is what holds up and sustains, as the earth holds up what stands on it.
Dharma is a rule made by kings who owned the land.

explanation.en: Dharma and dharati share the root dhri. Bhishma says that dharma "is that which upholds beings; whatever upholds all beings is dharma." The shared idea is upholding.

hints.en: What does the earth do for everything on it?
Look at the verb in Bhishma's line.
